unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft cut p4's reverie of reliving youth, so 'The future attracted him less' has nothing to be less than. The revision then deleted the wish to go 'back to the east' in the trade-winds. As a result, p7's 'the easiest path led back to the east' arrives with no stated longing behind it, and 'east' for the Pacific is unexplained.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'South Seas' is named in p5, so a careful reader can infer what 'east' means.

evidence.quote: He could always amuse himself by living over his youth, and driving once more down Oxford Street in 1858
Adams would rather, as choice, have gone back to the east, if it were only to sleep forever in the trade-winds
Adams would rather have gone back to the east, if it were only to sleep forever in the trade-winds under the southern stars.
The future attracted him less. He had just come up from the South Seas with John La Farge
He was ready to quit the world, and the easiest path led back to the east

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's one-sentence 'Adams would rather have gone back to the east…' and a short clause on amusing himself by living over his youth.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Paragraph 5 was optional for compression, not deletion of its motivating clause. Cutting p4's details is allowed, but this leaves a dangling residue.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: Readers lose the past-versus-future hinge and may find 'east' confusing after a South Seas reference.
unresolved_should_improve.title: London/South Seas transition: dangling comparative and unprepared 'east'

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The source says Adams's opinion of politicians lacked enthusiasm, and that he explained everything by Grant as a type. Both drafts drop the opinion clause. 'Everything' therefore has no referent, and the reference leans on omitted Grant chapters.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Chapter 021's revision keeps Grant as an inarticulate, money-awed type, which partly supports the allusion. The full global setup is unresolved because 019–020 are omitted.

evidence.quote: Adams's opinion of politics and politicians, as he frankly admitted, lacked enthusiasm
Adams explained everything by his old explanation of Grant's character as more or less a general type
Adams explained everything by his old explanation of Grant's character as more or less a general type

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Prefix: "Adams's opinion of politics and politicians, as he frankly admitted, lacked enthusiasm, and he explained everything by…"
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Planning omission: Chapters 019–020 are cut, so this allusion needs a local anchor.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The sentence reads as an unmotivated allusion. Readers cannot see that 'everything' means politicians' conduct.
unresolved_should_improve.title: 'Explained everything' by Grant's character lacks its subject

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision deleted the sentence naming the teacher as worst criminal, with the world dragging the student off course. 'The moral is stentorian' now follows only the generic conspiracy clause. Both drafts had already cut the closing claim that even the fittest waste three-fourths of their energy.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The essential 'society conspires to waste mind' survives.

evidence.quote: No doubt the teacher is the worst criminal, but the world stands behind him and drags the student from his course.
No doubt the teacher is the worst criminal, but the world stands behind him and drags the student from his course. The moral is stentorian.
society has conspired to promote it. The moral is stentorian.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's teacher/world sentence before 'The moral is stentorian.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: This sits within the essential opening purpose. The cut saves about 20 words at a voice cost.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This flattens the sharpest accusation in the restated purpose, which the plan marks essential. It also drops the indictment of teaching that follows from Chapter 022.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Teacher-as-criminal aphorism cut; 'moral is stentorian' loses its target

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The source's 'The combination offered no very glittering prizes' supplies the referent for 'it'. Both drafts cut that clause, so 'it' now points vaguely to 'trying to fill in the social gaps'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The meaning is recoverable from context.

evidence.quote: The combination offered no very glittering prizes, but they pursued it for twenty years
